spanish: Y mojará el sacerdote su dedo en la sangre, y rociará desde la sangre siete veces delante de Jehová, faces de parójet de la santidad.

findings.issue: Common noun left as the untranslated Hebraized form parójet; it must be Spanish.
Preposition את (with/toward) before the faces is omitted, so the sprinkling is not related to those faces.

notes: Priest, finger, blood, qal dip, hiphil sprinkle, seven times, and Jehová match the tokens.
